name: Cui Ge Lin Hotel
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Cui Ge Lin Hotel?
address: Near Dadouwu Reservoir, Fotang Village, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 1、在葛嶺步道旁邊，推開陽台門，入木就是後山竹林，特別喜歡。 2、來莫干山還是自駕吧，打車沒有那麼方便，去哪都有點距離，開車十分鐘-半小時。 3、我們四個很佛系，衹想躺平，所以叫老闆娘推薦了釣魚摘果子的地方，都很不錯👍 4、有個麻將房，我們正好四個人，每天六七點就回民宿搓麻將了哈哈哈哈，天天搓到十一二點，爽！ 5、最重要的是價格很便宜，在國慶假期真的很難找到3個晚上衹要800/人的民宿了 6、但可能是在山裡，房間很潮，被褥有點潮潮的味道，但老闆娘很及時地幫我們解決了，薅光了民宿剩下的枕頭和被子哈哈哈哈哈
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: It sits beside the Geling footpath, and opening the balcony door puts you straight into the bamboo on the hill behind, which I loved. Come to Moganshan by car if you can. Taxis are not that easy and everything is a little way off, ten minutes to half an hour of driving. The four of us wanted to do nothing at all, so we asked her to point us at fishing and fruit picking, and both were good. There is a mahjong room, and there were four of us, so we were back by six or seven every evening and played until eleven or twelve. Wonderful. Most of all it is cheap. Eight hundred a head for three nights over the National Day holiday is very hard to find. The one thing is damp, being up in the hills, and the bedding smelled slightly of it, though she dealt with it straight away and stripped the place of every spare pillow and quilt for us.
